messages:
morgan: Heads up — multiple customer tickets hitting 502/504 and timeouts on hosted-api since ~09:40 UTC. Spike aligns with a deploy at 09:36. Customers report partial failures and duplicate retries (billing noise). :rotating_light:
chris: Looking into it. Which rollout/flag was that?
morgan: Deploy bot posted rollout/feature/route-weights v2 at 09:36. Sample error from gateway: `504 read timeout to model-proxy` and `502 upstream prematurely closed connection`.
anika: Alerting: gateway 5xx rate in region-us-west jumped ~7% at 09:38. Canary was 15% traffic. My guess — a timing/batching change slipped into canary.
ben: Can someone paste the effective flag config for the route? I'll check routing tables and shedder metrics.
support-bot: incident created INC-2026-0041 (severity P2) — linked: support tickets #12345, #12346, #12347.
liz: Quick local repro: curl to /v1/generate with a ~700-token prompt returns 502 with `upstream prematurely closed connection`. Same request with <300 tokens succeeds.
chris: That smells like kv-cache/batching window interaction. @anika did the rollout include any batch/prefetch changes?
anika: Yes — the v2 variant toggled `batch_max_wait_ms` from 5 -> 50 to improve throughput and enabled a prefetch flag `route_prefetch_window=true`. That flag should NOT have applied to canary, but config inheritance merged it in for the canary subset.
morgan: Impacted customers reported increased latency and retries that caused extra billed tokens. We need rollback + customer comms.
ben: I'm rolling the flag back now. Running: `deployctl set-flag route_prefetch_window=false --release rollout/feature/route-weights --env prod --scope canary`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag update queued (op id=f4a1). Applying change to 15 canary hosts.
chris: Monitoring dashboards — 5xx% dropping. At +60s after rollback the canary 5xx rate down from 7% -> ~1.2%. Latency p50 also improving.
liz: Model-proxy logs confirm fewer `prematurely closed connection` entries. Re-running ACME repro now returns 200.
morgan: Replying to affected customers: rollback in progress, please validate. Opening billing follow-up for retries/refunds.
anika: Root cause summary: flag inheritance bug when merging route-level flags with staged rollout variants. PR #3490 will guard config merge path; will backpatch to stable branch.
ben: Will hold this rollout paused for 30m and re-run with corrected config after sign-off & load test.
support-bot: incident INC-2026-0041 updated — status=mitigated, severity downgraded=P3.
chris: Action items: @anika create patch and test, @liz run targeted load tests with seq>512 payloads, @deploy-bot maintain audit for reattempt, ops to draft customer billing notes. I'll coordinate the postmortem.
morgan: Thanks everyone — great quick turnaround :thumbsup: 
ben: Leaving watches on until we hit sustained normal for 15m.
liz: I'll post the load-test results in the follow-up thread.
chris: Closing incident channel when postmortem doc is linked.
morgan: I'll update customer tickets once the billing plan is ready.
